message.content: Morning. Quick check on the Stellenbosch wedding prep. Did Lerato confirm?

content.text: Yes, Thandiwe. Lerato Mokoena agreed to second-shoot. She confirmed on Thursday 26 March.

message.content: Great. That’s a weight off my shoulders. Now, I’m stressed about Bongo. I need someone to walk him on the days of the Stellenbosch shoot, but I haven’t sorted that yet. Can you help me find a reliable walker for next Tuesday and Wednesday?

content.text: I can look for available walkers in your area for those days. Are you looking for someone to come to your home in Cape Town, or do you need a drop-off service?

message.content: Drop-off is better. I’ll be out all day. Also, while we’re at it, can you draft a quick message to Sipho? I need to remind him to pick up the catering deposit from the bank before he heads to work this morning.

content.text: Here is the draft for Sipho: 'Hi Sipho, just a reminder to pick up the catering deposit from the bank before you head to work this morning. Thanks!'

message.content: Perfect, send it. And for the walker, please filter for someone who specializes in large breeds. Bongo can be a bit much for casual walkers.

content.text: I’ve found three profiles of walkers in Cape Town who specialize in large breeds and are available next Tuesday and Wednesday. I’ll send you their links and rates. Would you like me to book a trial walk for Bongo with the first option this weekend?

message.content: Yes, let’s do that. And please add the catering deposit reminder to my calendar for today at 7:30 AM just in case he forgets.

content.text: Done. The reminder is set for 7:30 AM today. I’ve also sent the walker profiles to your inbox. Let me know which one you’d like to proceed with for the trial.
